name: STARBUX Refuel Terminal
address: 4400 Frontage Access Road, Bay 7, Pump Court Commons, Loam Springs
about: STARBUX Refuel Terminal is a beverage refueling facility operating under a hospitality license. Product is dispensed by volume through calibrated brass hoses rather than poured. Vessel classes above Municipal require a compatible residence and a floor drain.
announcement: Watershed dispense is temporarily suspended at this terminal pending a drain inspection. Regional remains fully available and is, in most respects, larger.

reviews.name: Delphine R.
reviews.text: Ordered a Municipal and they asked for my building's drain certificate. Extremely professional. I did not have one.

reviews.name: Corwin B.
reviews.text: The foam deck held a spoon upright for the entire commute. Only complaint is that the spoon was billed separately.

reviews.name: Marisol T.
reviews.text: I declined syrup and was charged the same as accepting it. The receipt explained why in a way I found persuasive.

reviews.name: Hollis K.
reviews.text: Good product. The hose reel retracted while I was still under it and that is on me.

reviews.name: Aggie W.
reviews.text: My Gorger delivered eleven gallons in a tote and left without speaking. Correct temperature throughout.

menu.name: Bulk Dispense Bay
menu.blurb: Hose-fed product, metered at the nozzle. Bring a vessel or lease one at the counter.

items.name: Terminal Latte
items.desc: Espresso and steamed dairy substrate delivered through the primary dispensing hose at a regulated fourteen liters per minute. The vessel is filled until the vessel objects.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a colossal clear glass latte vessel the size of a bucket, shot as a three-quarter hero, filled past the rim with stratified espresso and steamed milk, a thick sagging dome of microfoam swelling over the lip and slumping down the outside in slow white ropes, condensation beading on the glass, milk runnels pooling on the stone, a heavy brass dispensing nozzle still dripping directly above it. Setting: a polished white marble counter with industrial brass dispensing hoses and pressure gauges mounted behind it, warm cafe bokeh. Lighting: soft north-facing window light with a warm amber bounce, gentle contrast, premium lifestyle photography. Camera: 85mm, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, creamy falloff. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Family (96 oz)
options.note: Two-hand carry advised.

options.name: Municipal (2.5 gal)
options.note: Dispensed at the bay, not the counter.

options.name: Watershed (11.4 gal)
options.note: Requires a compatible residence and a floor drain.

options.name: Twenty-Six Pumps
options.note: Beverage becomes structurally self-supporting.

options.name: Zero Pumps
options.note: Withheld syrup is still metered, logged, and billed at parity.

options.name: Second Foam Deck
options.note: Load-bearing. Rated to one pastry.

items.name: Nitrogen Standpipe Cold Brew
items.desc: Twenty-hour cold extraction charged with nitrogen and released through the standpipe coupling. The cascade continues for the first four minutes and is not a defect.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: shot straight down into the open mouth of a tall brushed-steel refuel vessel brimming with nitrogen-infused cold brew, a dense cascading surge of microbubbles climbing the near-black liquid in visible banded waves, a thick tan crema head domed above the rim under surface tension and just beginning to weep over one edge, a brass hose coupling clamped to the vessel collar at the frame edge, cold condensation streaking the steel. Setting: a polished white marble counter with industrial brass dispensing hoses and pressure gauges mounted behind it, warm cafe bokeh. Lighting: soft north-facing window light with a warm amber bounce, gentle contrast, premium lifestyle photography. Camera: 50mm, f/4, top-down, crisp surface detail. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Fire-Rated 38mm
options.note: The bay is cleared before dispense.

options.name: No Ice
options.note: Volume you did not lose is billed as retained product.

options.name: Second Nitrogen Charge
options.note: Cascade duration extends to nine minutes.

items.name: Flat Volume White
items.desc: A flat white scaled up until flatness became a structural claim rather than a texture. Surface is level to within two millimeters across the vessel.

options.name: Substrate Withheld
options.note: Substrate is prepared, withheld, and disposed of. Disposal is a service.

options.name: Municipal (2.5 gal)
options.note: Levelling tolerance no longer guaranteed above Family.

options.name: Full Aroma Release in Bay
options.note: Aroma is released on premises and does not travel with the order.

items.name: Americano, Metered
items.desc: Espresso and municipal-grade hot water combined at a ratio declared by you and recorded by us. The declaration is binding for the duration of the order.

options.name: Declared 1:31
options.note: Beverage is legally water with a history.

options.name: Decline to Declare
options.note: Undeclared ratios are assigned by the terminal at a premium.

options.name: Nineteen Shots
options.note: Physician discouraged. Physician not consulted.

options.name: Brass Agitator Rod
options.note: Returned at the terminal or retained at full replacement value.

items.name: Drip Coffee, Continuous Feed
items.desc: Standard roast supplied on an open line for a duration you select. The line does not stop early and cannot be paused once opened.

options.name: Standing Feed (Until Close)
options.note: Feed terminates at 11:45 PM regardless of vessel state.

options.name: Curbside Reach (140 ft)
options.note: Hose crosses the sidewalk. Pedestrians are notified by sign.

options.name: Return Vessel to Terminal
options.note: Return processing fee. The vessel remains ours.

menu.name: Espresso Pressure Vessels
menu.blurb: Small format. Nine bars minimum. Priced by what it took to get there.

items.name: Quadruple Ristretto Cartridge
items.desc: Four short-drawn shots sealed into a thick-walled glass cartridge and rated to internal pressure. Crema depth exceeds liquid depth by design.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: extreme macro of four ristretto shots crowded into a small thick-walled glass pressure cartridge, mottled tiger-striped crema swelling above the rim in a taut convex meniscus, individual oil droplets and micro-bubbles rendered razor sharp, one amber thread of espresso still falling into the surface and denting it, a hairline of coffee film creeping down the outer glass. Setting: a polished white marble counter with industrial brass dispensing hoses and pressure gauges mounted behind it, warm cafe bokeh. Lighting: soft north-facing window light with a warm amber bounce, gentle contrast, premium lifestyle photography. Camera: 100mm macro, f/3.5, paper-thin plane of focus, high micro-contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Bandolier of Nine
options.note: Supplied in a shoulder rack. Rack is not returnable.

options.name: Punitive
options.note: Grounds are compacted to a disc and disposed of as aggregate.

items.name: Macchiato, Marked
items.desc: Espresso marked with dairy to a depth you specify. The mark is measured before handoff and the measurement appears on the receipt.

options.name: Full-Column Mark
options.note: At this depth the beverage is a latte. It is still a macchiato.

options.name: No Mark
options.note: The mark is measured, recorded as zero, and billed as a measurement.

options.name: Grade AA, Rigid
options.note: Cap must be broken with an implement before drinking.

options.name: Terminal Syrup Blend
options.note: Formulation is proprietary and changes without notice.

items.name: Cortado Compliance Unit
items.desc: Equal parts espresso and warmed dairy, verified by a scale at the counter. Units failing verification are dispensed anyway and noted.

options.name: Witnessed and Countersigned
options.note: A second employee observes the pour and signs the ticket.

options.name: Compliance Waived
options.note: Waiver is processed by the same staff at the same cost.

options.name: Band 6 (Scalding)
options.note: Band 6 is offered and is not recommended.

options.name: Weighted Brass Saucer
options.note: Saucer weighs more than the beverage. This is intentional.

items.name: Espresso Reserve Draw
items.desc: A single draw from the reserve line, which is kept behind glass and opened on request. Provenance is attested rather than proven.

options.name: Attested Single Shrub
options.note: The shrub is identified by number and is not visitable.

options.name: Attestation Declined
options.note: The attestation is prepared regardless and filed unread.

options.name: Reserve Line Purge
options.note: The entire reserve line is emptied into your vessel.

options.name: Notes Read Aloud at Handoff
options.note: Recital lasts ninety seconds and cannot be shortened.

menu.name: Cold Foam Structural Systems
menu.blurb: Foam is a layer, a material, and a line item. Decks are rated before they leave the bay.

items.name: Salted Foam Deck Mocha
items.desc: Chocolate sludge, espresso, and dairy in declared strata beneath a salted cold foam deck rated to support one standard pastry. Do not exceed the rating.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a cafe employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a tall iced mocha in a plain clear plastic to-go cup, dark chocolate syrup at the bottom, a band of espresso, milk above it and a thick pale layer of salted cold foam on top with caramel drizzled over it running down the inside of the cup, condensation on the plastic, a clear domed lid lying upside down beside it. Dim warm cafe light with the flash off, slightly underexposed and noisy. Shot from too close and slightly above so the cup is not centred in the frame, a stainless espresso machine and steel milk jugs blurred behind on the counter. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Grade V (Rated to One Pastry)
options.note: Rating assumes a level vessel and no lateral movement.

options.name: No Deck
options.note: The deck is whipped, graded, and discarded. Grading is billable.

options.name: Full Lattice
options.note: Lattice is applied by machine and cannot be reversed.

options.name: Sludge Reinforcement at Base
options.note: Adds mass at the bottom to resist tipping.

items.name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Overburden
items.desc: Cold brew beneath an overburden of sweet cream measured in vertical inches. Overburden depth is set at the bay and cannot be adjusted afterward.

options.name: Nine Inches
options.note: Beverage is majority overburden by volume.

options.name: Overburden Omitted
options.note: Omission is a depth of zero and is measured like any other depth.

options.name: Regional (6 gal)
options.note: Delivered in a wheeled tote by a second Gorger.

options.name: Notarized Statement
options.note: Notary attends the terminal on Tuesdays.

items.name: Matcha Substrate Column
items.desc: Ceremonial-adjacent green powder suspended in dairy substrate and held as a standing column. The column settles within eleven minutes and this is expected.

options.name: Full Tin
options.note: The column will not settle. It will remain a column.

options.name: No Powder
options.note: Dosage is weighed out, returned to the tin, and billed as handling.

options.name: Hand Whisked, Four Minutes
options.note: Labor is billed by the minute at terminal rate.

items.name: Chai Load-Bearing Latte
items.desc: Spiced concentrate and steamed substrate assembled to a stated load rating. Ratings are conservative and assume the vessel remains upright.

options.name: Rated to a Second Beverage
options.note: Stacking beyond two vessels voids the rating.

options.name: Unrated
options.note: An unrated beverage is still inspected. Inspection is the charge.

options.name: Terminal Deck
options.note: Contains clove at a concentration disclosed on request.

menu.name: Seasons Not Currently Occurring
menu.blurb: Seasonal product tied to intervals the calendar does not recognize. Availability is continuous.

items.name: Pumpkin Interval Latte
items.desc: The flagship seasonal beverage of an interval that has not been observed since 1997. Served with a whipped canopy that exceeds the vessel in every direction.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a cafe employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a hot orange-brown spiced pumpkin latte in a plain white paper to-go cup, a heavy pile of whipped cream heaped above the rim and dusted with cinnamon, some cream slumped down one side of the cup, the plastic lid lying next to it on the counter. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the whipped cream, hard black shadow thrown behind the cup. Cluttered background: a stainless steel counter, a stack of lids, a rack of syrup bottles and another drink waiting. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Attest Nothing
options.note: The terminal will attest on your behalf and bill the same.

options.name: Cantilevered Canopy
options.note: Canopy extends beyond the vessel and is not covered by spill policy.

items.name: Peppermint Quarter Cocoa
items.desc: Cocoa formulated for a fiscal quarter rather than a month. Peppermint content is fixed by policy and cannot be reduced.

options.name: Q7 Formulation
options.note: Q7 does not exist. The formulation does.

options.name: No Designation
options.note: Undesignated cocoa is designated by the terminal at the same rate.

options.name: Sliceable
options.note: Supplied with a serrated implement at no additional charge.

options.name: Suspended Throughout
options.note: Shards do not dissolve within the delivery window.

items.name: Second Harvest Maple Fog
items.desc: A steamed maple beverage finished with an aerosolized fog layer. The fog persists for the duration of transit under normal conditions.

options.name: Harvest Unknown
options.note: An unknown harvest is researched, not resolved, and billed as research.

options.name: Advisory Fog
options.note: Vessel contents will not be visible at handoff.

items.name: Unseasonal Red Refresher
items.desc: A chilled beverage in a red that does not correspond to any fruit currently in season. Freeze-dried inclusions are added at the bay.

options.name: Refuse the Waiver
options.note: Refusal is documented, filed, and processed at the extended rate.

options.name: Inclusions Only, No Liquid
options.note: Supplied dry in the vessel. Liquid may be purchased separately.

menu.name: The Glass Case
menu.blurb: Baked goods held under glass at ambient temperature. Retrieval is a separate operation.

items.name: Structural Cinnamon Coil
items.desc: A twelve-revolution cinnamon coil baked as a single continuous member. Glaze is applied by volume and runs off the edges by design.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a cafe employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: one very large cinnamon roll with many tight coils, thick white glaze poured over the top and pooled around the base, dark cinnamon filling visible between the coils, sitting on a plain white paper plate. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Framed slightly crooked with the paper plate cut off at the bottom edge, sitting on a scratched laminate counter with crumbs and a sticky smear of glaze beside it. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Case Oven, Four Minutes
options.note: The coil will lose its shape and will still be delivered.

options.name: No Warming
options.note: The oven is cycled regardless. Cycling is billed as warming.

options.name: Submerged and Drained
options.note: Drain time is thirty minutes and occurs after your order is placed.

options.name: Sealed Containment Sleeve
options.note: Recommended for coils above the Family class.

items.name: Cake Pop, Load-Rated
items.desc: A spherical cake mass on a stick certified to a stated load. The certification is for the stick, not the sphere.

options.name: Steel Stick
options.note: Steel is rated to nine spheres. Nine spheres are not included.

options.name: No Stick
options.note: The sphere is certified without a stick at the hardwood rate.

options.name: Full Case Opening
options.note: The entire case is opened and the ambient temperature is reset.

items.name: Laminated Butter Slab
items.desc: A rectangular laminated pastry sold by the slab. Layer count is declared at order and is audited at the bakery, not at the terminal.

options.name: 729 Layers
options.note: Slab weight approaches that of a Personal vessel.

options.name: Layer Count Unspecified
options.note: Unspecified slabs are counted after baking and billed at the median.

options.name: Full Disclosure with Weights
options.note: Disclosure is longer than this menu section.

options.name: Bisected Into Nine
options.note: Bisection into nine is performed with a bench scraper and is imprecise.

items.name: Breakfast Sandwich, Terminal Grade
items.desc: Egg product, a protein disc, and a cheese analogue assembled on a bread-shaped object of your choosing. Griddle assignment determines finish quality.

options.name: No Bread-Shaped Object
options.note: Contents are supplied stacked. Stacking is a preparation.

options.name: Reserved Griddle
options.note: The griddle is cleared of all other orders for the duration.
